info.name: AgaveLens API
info.description: GraphQL analytics API for AgaveLens, a validator-internals analytics node. Ingest slot-level validator telemetry and query rayon-aggregated skip-rate / slot-time / vote-latency percentiles. This is a read-mostly analytics surface: queries + an ingest mutation, no subscriptions. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default http://localhost:8080). Start the server with `agavelens-node serve`. Ingest is rate-limited (token bucket) and batch-size guarded (max 10,000 samples per call); the sample store is bounded (default 200,000) and evicts oldest-first.

request.description: Ingest a batch of slot samples. `epoch` is optional — when omitted it is derived from the slot using the configured slots-per-epoch. A batch larger than the configured max (10,000) errors with code `batch_too_large`; exceeding the ingest rate limit errors with code `throttled`. Empty leader ids are rejected (`empty_validator`).
Whole-fleet analytics snapshot. Percentiles are computed in parallel with rayon inside a spawn_blocking task so the async runtime is never blocked.
Validators ranked by skip rate (worst first), tie-broken by slots led desc then validator id asc.
Per-validator analytics. Returns null when the validator has no recorded samples.
Compact summary for a single epoch. Returns null when the epoch has no samples.
